svg.title: Private endpoint traffic flow
svg.desc: A private endpoint with IP 10.2.1.5 in a spoke VNet fronts a storage account with public access disabled. A VM in the spoke and an on-premises client over VPN or ExpressRoute (through the hub gateway and optional Azure Firewall) both connect to the private IP. The DNS Private Resolver answers from a private DNS zone linked to the hub. Public clients reach the storage public endpoint over the internet and are blocked.
svg.text: Blocked at the public endpoint: public network access is disabled
